name: Bulk filtering
summary: Keep or discard each item in a batch under a stated rule.

input.state: The caller's filter rule followed by one item's text.

keep.instructions: The item satisfies the filter rule the state opens with.
keep.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

outputs.shape: one boolean per item; the caller keeps items answered true

cost.bound: bounded by the door's classify input limit; loop items as classify inputs, not one giant state

uncertainty.abstain: an item the rule cannot judge answers discard; the caller treats it as filtered out, not judged irrelevant
uncertainty.refusal: a refused item reports refused; the caller re-queues it rather than discarding silently

limits: The rule is a caller-supplied premise, not a learned classifier - precision follows the rule's wording.
Per-item noul gives no ranking; use retrieval-rerank when order matters.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
